events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders and forever an icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still a rock 'n' roll star, still setting trends.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Licence to thrill, indeed.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Paying tribute to the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The acclaimed comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese. Still making us laugh, still a comedy legend.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the world lost the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Queen's Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we said goodbye to the one and only Freddie Mercury. His legacy, and that incredible voice, live on forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today, a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game and showed their incredible progression.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, whose life was tragically cut short 46 years ago today.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and vision for peace continue to resonate globally.
